svg.title: RAG Agent: real CLI ingestion and query
svg.desc: Recorded stdout rendered as a terminal transcript. No answers are mocked or edited.

g.text: $ rag-agent ask "Who created Python and when was it first released?"
La syntaxe Python est créée par Guido van Rossum en 1991. La première version du langage est
compilée à l'aide d'un interpréteur Python, CPython.
[1] tests/fixtures/knowledge.md — e. A strong colony can store more than 25 kilograms of honey for
the winter. Python programming language Python is a general-purpose programming language created by
